body.heading: Where in the world is Bhutan?
paragraphs: Bhutan is a country in Southern Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Bhutan is Thimphu.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Bhutan is Dzongkha.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Bhutan is the Bhutanese ngultrum.

body.heading: How big is Bhutan?
paragraphs: Bhutan covers about 38,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Georgia.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Tiger's Nest clings to a cliff 900 metres above the Paro valley. The hike up through pine forest to this sacred monastery is Bhutan's most famous adventure.
Punakha Dzong is a fortress-monastery of white walls and golden roofs where two rivers meet — many call it the most beautiful building in Bhutan.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Bhutan on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
